import numpy as np
from scipy import stats

MAX_DRIVERS = 2

def design(feats):
    # Calculate effect sizes and p-values for all features
    effect_sizes = []
    p_values = []
    
    for i, fid in enumerate(feats.ids):
        x = feats.x[:, i]
        y = feats.y
        
        # Effect size: mean difference between groups
        mean_y1 = np.mean(x[y == 1])
        mean_y0 = np.mean(x[y == 0])
        effect_size = mean_y1 - mean_y0
        
        # Welch's t-test
        group0 = x[y == 0]
        group1 = x[y == 1]
        if len(group0) > 1 and len(group1) > 1:
            t_stat, p_val = stats.ttest_ind(group0, group1, equal_var=False)
        else:
            p_val = 1.0
            
        effect_sizes.append(effect_size)
        p_values.append(p_val)
    
    # Select top features based on effect size and significance
    # Keep only features with |effect_size| > 0.3 and p < 0.05
    selected_indices = [i for i in range(len(feats.ids)) 
                       if abs(effect_sizes[i]) > 0.3 and p_values[i] < 0.05]
    
    # Sort by effect size magnitude
    selected_indices.sort(key=lambda i: abs(effect_sizes[i]), reverse=True)
    
    # Take top 2 as drivers
    drivers = tuple(feats.ids[i] for i in selected_indices[:MAX_DRIVERS])
    
    # Use all significant features for regression
    columns = tuple(feats.ids[i] for i in selected_indices)
    
    # No interactions to keep model small
    products = ()
    
    # Loadings based on effect sizes
    loadings = {feats.ids[i]: effect_sizes[i] for i in selected_indices}
    
    return Design(drivers=drivers, columns=columns, products=products, loadings=loadings)
